title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Customer Platform (Poland, Remote, B2B)
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role: 

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

- Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.

- Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.

- Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.

- Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

The long-term opportunity is rooted in the physical world. Deployed hardware, data generated at the edge, and years of operational expertise form a foundation that's hard to replicate. As AI advances, it expands what we can build on that foundation. This is a place to develop deep engineering expertise while helping shape a platform with years of ambitious work ahead.

AI is also central to how we build. We expect engineers to push tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor throughout design, implementation, testing, and production investigations, taking on more ambitious work while owning the quality of what they ship.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Poland.

In this role, you will: 

- Build foundational capabilities for Samsara’s agentic experiences, enabling AI agents to securely discover data, use tools, integrate with external systems, and execute reliable workflows at enterprise scale.

- Design systems for high throughput, availability, observability, security, and maintainability.

- Apply AI assistants, including Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor - across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review.

- Improve frameworks, tooling, and engineering practices that increase the effectiveness of teams across Samsara.

- Mentor other engineers and contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team 

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 4+ years of relevant engineering experience , with a track record of shipping and improving production software.

- Proven end-to-end ownership of a product, substantial feature, or subsystem through design, implementation, launch, and iteration.

- Ability to take a clear customer or business challenge, independently choose a technical approach, and balance delivery speed, quality, and maintainability.

- Experience driving delivery with engineers and product or design partners, and helping teammates improve through reviews, technical feedback, or mentoring.

- Extensive practical use of AI across investigation, design, implementation, testing, and review, while owning the correctness and quality of the result.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Designing and operating public-facing REST or GraphQL APIs.

- High-throughput event-streaming platform.

- Building extensible integration or application frameworks.

- Distributed data-fetching, query execution, reporting, or analytical systems.

- Experience in any one of these areas is a plus. Exposure should come from production work.

- Reporting and data systems: Reporting products, analytics, query execution, data retrieval, or turning complex datasets into useful customer experiences.

- Enterprise administration: Permissions and access control, entity metadata, configuration frameworks, or customer onboarding and setup automation.

- Developer and agent platforms: Public APIs, event-driven systems, integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or tools that let AI agents access data and take action.

- Billing and monetization: Billing systems, license assignment, product entitlements, or usage metering supporting how a business sells and delivers its products.

- Full-stack product development: Building complete customer experiences across frontend interfaces, backend services, and data models.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
description:
Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona

URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ 

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.

We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.

This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. 

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. 

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

- Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles

- Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering

- Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management

- Job and project tracking

- Client and vendor dashboards

- Online payments and transaction tracking

- Reviews and ratings

- Notifications and communications

- Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities

- Admin tools for managing the platform

- Reporting and analytics

- Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. 

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

- Full-stack web development

- Mobile or cross-platform app development

- Strong front-end and back-end development

- Multi-user marketplace platforms

- User authentication and account management

- Payment gateway integrations

- Databases and APIs

- Third-party integrations

- Dashboards and reporting

- Secure, scalable application architecture

- Cloud hosting and deployment

- Testing, maintenance, and optimization

- Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications

If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it.

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.

Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.

This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.

Interested? Tell Us About Yourself

Please send us:

- A quick introduction

- Your resume or LinkedIn profile

- Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built

- Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on

- What you personally worked on for those projects

- Your experience using AI in development

- What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why

- Your availability

A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.

Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

title: Mid Level Front End Engineer
description:
Front-End Engineer (Mid-Level) Job Description 

Owning a home has slipped out of reach for millions of Americans. Cedar has built a model that changes that, we’ve proven it by closing deals, and now we’re scaling. As our mid-level front-end engineer, you’ll build what people touch every day: the screens a family uses to figure out whether Cedar can get them into a home. You get the stability of a company that’s proven its model, plus the ownership and scope of an early hire.

How we work: results over hours, straight feedback, and problems fixed at the root. People who learn fast and take ownership earn serious responsibility quickly. The bar is high, but you won’t be clearing it alone, and the people around you are very good at what they do.

AI is central to how we build. We invest heavily in our tooling so a small team can ship like a much bigger one, and we want people who keep pushing on what these tools can do. They are meant to speed you up, not to think for you, and you own the result.

What you’ll get 

- 
Ownership from week one. You’ll be shipping to customers, not waiting around for permission.

- 
Room to grow. Take on more as soon as you’re ready, not on a fixed timeline.

- 
A small, sharp team and tooling that’s a pleasure to work with, so your time goes to the interesting problems.

- 
Competitive pay and meaningful equity, so you share in what you help build.

Responsibilities 

- 
Build and own the consumer-facing web app in React, TypeScript, and Next.js.

- 
Lean on our AI tooling to ship quickly, and help make it better as you go.

- 
Be fanatical about testing your assumptions and judging your work by outcomes. AI speeds you up, but it doesn’t think for you, so the verification is on you.

- 
Take dense financial logic and turn it into screens people can understand and trust.

- 
Work shoulder to shoulder with design and product, from rough idea to shipped, accessible UI.

- 
Own features from build to release, then watch how people use them and make them better.

- 
Keep the bar high in code review, write tests that matter, and chase bugs to their root cause.

Your first 90 days 

- 
First couple of weeks: get set up, ship a small change to production, and learn how we work.

- 
First month: own a feature end to end, from design handoff through release.

- 
By 90 days: you’re the go-to person for a meaningful slice of the consumer app.

Skills 

- 
A few years (roughly 3+) building production web apps with React and TypeScript.

- 
You’re solid on HTML and CSS, and you make things work on a phone, not just a laptop.

- 
You’ve worked with APIs, REST or GraphQL, and testing is just part of how you build.

- 
You’re excited about our AI tooling and want to push it further.

- 
You work well independently and enjoy the back-and-forth between product, design, and engineering.

- 
Bonus: a good eye for design and comfort working in Figma.

- 
Bonus: you’ve worked on accessibility (WCAG) before.

Location 

Remote-first and full-time. You can work from anywhere in the US, and a good number of us are around New York City if you’d rather not work solo.

You’ll report to Brien Kurtz, our VP of Engineering.

Compensation 

Total cash compensation is between $100K and $150K, made up of base and a discretionary bonus, and it comes with significant equity plus benefits. We’re serious about the equity, so you own a piece of what you help build.

Benefits 

- 
Medical, dental, and vision coverage.

- 
401(k) retirement plan.

- 
Paid time off and parental leave.

- 
A stipend to set up your home office the way you want it.

Equal opportunity 

Cedar is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants of every background, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. If you need an accommodation at any point in the hiring process, just let us know.

title: Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention . Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability. 

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries. 

This position is based in Rennes, France. 

The Solutions Engineer at IDnow is the client's trusted advisor through pre-sales and integration . You design the solution the client will rely on, you give them confidence that it will work in their environment, and you become the person they turn to for technical and solution decisions. Your focus is the technical side of the journey up to the point where the client is live on our products, and you make that path smooth . 

This is a hands-on, deeply technical role, and a commercial one . Solutions Engineers carry a quota and are measured on two things: the deals they help win, and whether the client goes live successfully. You work hand in hand with Sales to convince the client that our solution is the right one and to move them toward signature, and then you make sure they can use it well in production. You earn that through technical depth, but you are client-facing, credible and persuasive in a sales motion. You do this across our whole client base.

We hire this role at more than one level. The core of the job is the same; the scope you own and the complexity you handle grow with your experience. This role carries real ownership across the client journey, and a say in how the work evolves.

Key Responsibilities

Discover and Design

- Lead technical discovery, qualifying conversion rates, false acceptance and rejection trade-offs, fraud exposure and integration constraints before proposing a solution,

- Design end-to-end solution architectures that orchestrate document verification, digital identity, fraud signals, biometric authentication, eID and EU Digital Identity Wallet flows, and e-signature,

- Link every technical choice to the client’s business objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), so proposals speak to outcomes rather than features,

- Define defensible architecture decisions covering fallback logic, data residency, scalability and performance,

- Support Sales with proposals, Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), advising on which capabilities to combine and why.

Prove, Integrate and Go Live

- Lead proof-of-concept and pilot engagements, configuring Application Programming Interface (API) integrations, building Postman collections and managing sandbox environments,

- Validate behaviour under realistic conditions and document what the client needs to go live,

- Guide client developers through API and mobile Software Development Kit (SDK) integration, including webhooks, authentication and testing,

- Troubleshoot integration issues by reading logs and diagnosing failures at the API and SDK level, rather than only forwarding them,

- Maintain a living integration map of the client’s architecture, data flows and dependencies,

- Own the account from signature to go-live, running the go-live plan and handing a documented account to Customer Success and Support at the end of hypercare.

Advise and Enable

- Build trusted advisor relationships with business and technical stakeholders, from first conversation to go-live,

- Represent the client’s technical reality internally, feeding integration blockers, product gaps and pilot learnings back to Product and Sales teams,

- Work with the internal escalation team on deeper platform issues, arriving with clear technical context,

- Stand alongside Sales in client meetings, addressing objections on integration effort, feasibility and alternatives,

- Improve demo environments, architecture templates and integration guides, and mentor team members as the practice grows.

Preferred Experience

You ask before you propose and qualify before you demo, turning ambiguous client requirements into the right technical solution. You take ownership of the client’s technical path from first conversation to production, and you explain complex systems in plain language to engineers and business leaders alike. You combine hands-on engineering depth with a commercial mindset, and you enjoy working alongside Sales to move a decision forward.

- Engineering or technical degree , a Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience,

- 3+ years of experience in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or implementation and onboarding in SaaS , ideally in identity, FinTech or security,

- Discovery and qualification skills , with the ability to turn an ambiguous client requirement into the best technical solution,

- Solution architecture skills , including designing integration flows, explaining orchestration logic and defending trade-offs with a client’s engineers,

- Hands-on technical skills with APIs, Software Development Kits (SDKs) including mobile, and integration tooling such as Postman and Git,

- Experience running a proof of concept and debugging an integration at the API or log level,

- Delivery discipline to run an integration and onboarding through to a committed go-live date, managing several client projects at once,

- The ability to translate technical complexity into plain language and reassure non-technical stakeholders,

- Business value awareness , connecting the technical solution to client outcomes such as verification conversion, fraud loss or time to go-live,

- Client-facing presence, building trusted advisor relationships with business stakeholders such as Chief Digital Officers (CDOs) and Heads of Digital, and technical stakeholders such as Chief Technology Officers (CTOs), architects and platform engineers,

- The instinct to own the client’s technical path end to end,

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. 

Als Senior Quality Engineer – Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden. 

Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen. 

- Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung. 

- Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen. Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden. 

- Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung. 

- Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen. 

- Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests. 

- Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen. 

- Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung. 

- Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann. 

Das bringst du mit: 

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests. 

- Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaScript und praktische Erfahrung mit Playwright oder einem vergleichbaren Framework. Du kannst sicher in einer Playwright-basierten Codebasis arbeiten. 

- Erfahrung mit CI-Pipelines, Git, Code-Reviews, reproduzierbaren Testumgebungen und der Fehlersuche mithilfe von Logs, Traces und Anwendungscode. 

- Verständnis von HTTP-APIs, Authentifizierung, asynchroner Verarbeitung und Zustandsübergängen – einschließlich der Frage, wie sich Fehler- und Wiederholungsverhalten testen lässt. 

- Die Fähigkeit, unklare Produktanforderungen in testbare Szenarien zu übersetzen, nach Risiko zu priorisieren und sinnvolle Arbeitsschritte umzusetzen – und bei Bedarf Unterstützung einzuholen. 

- Eine kooperative Haltung: Du arbeitest gern im Team, lernst neugierig von anderen und gibst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung gern weiter. 

- Klare mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation auf Englisch sowie Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Entwickler:innen und Produktkolleg:innen zu Qualitätsrisiken und Release-Entscheidungen. 

Von Vorteil: 

Erfahrung mit Zahlungsanbietern, E-Commerce oder Finanztransaktionen ist hilfreich. Ebenso willkommen sind Kenntnisse in PHP/Symfony, Shopware, API-Vertragstests auf OpenAPI-Basis, containerisierten Umgebungen oder mandantenfähigen Services. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungs- und Testwerkzeugen ist ebenfalls willkommen, sofern die Ergebnisse eigenständig geprüft und verifiziert werden. 

Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in jedem der genannten Bereiche Erfahrung mitbringen, um dich zu bewerben. Kenntnisse in Shopware oder PayPal sind keine Voraussetzung. 

Woran Erfolg gemessen wird: 

Deine ersten Prioritäten legst du während des Onboardings gemeinsam mit Product, Engineering und dem Quality-Engineering-Team fest. Dazu gehören: 

- Eine aktuelle Übersicht der kritischen Payments-Abläufe, der bestehenden Testabdeckung und der wichtigsten Lücken – mit klar zugeordneten Umsetzungsverantwortlichkeiten. 

- Ein erster Kauf- und Zahlungsablauf, der zuverlässig in der CI oder innerhalb eines vereinbarten Release-Gates ausgeführt wird, das Bestell- und Zahlungsergebnis prüft und aussagekräftige Hinweise bei Fehlern liefert.

Der Fortschritt wird anhand der tatsächlich funktionierenden Testabdeckung, der Zuverlässigkeit der Tests und der Aussagekraft von Release-Entscheidungen bewertet – nicht allein anhand der Anzahl der Tests oder des Umfangs der Dokumentation. 

Das bieten wir dir:

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

We are looking for Fullstack Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation. 

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use. 

Responsibilities 

- Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively. 

- Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on. 

- Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers. 

- Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring. 

- Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably. 

- Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs. 

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them. 

- Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js skills. 

- Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review. 

- Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures. 

- A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior. 

- Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team. 

Important information for candidates 
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

- Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

- Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

- Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

- Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io 

- We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We're looking for an engineer who can build that end-to-end. You'll have a frontend focus (strong JavaScript/TypeScript and real front-end craft) while operating as a full-stack product engineer.

How we work 

Engineers at Help Scout own their work end-to-end — from problem definition through production, and from the customer signal that shaped the bet to the dashboard that tells you whether it landed. You're full-stack capable, customer-fluent, and genuinely fast with AI tools.

- 
We develop in TypeScript, React , Kotlin, Java, and PHP.

- 
We leverage Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Kafka, Flink, RabbitMQ, MySQL, and PostgreSQL — plus vector search and LLM tooling for our AI features.

- 
We're heavy users of the AWS ecosystem, Slack, GitHub, and Linear.

- 
We use AI tools — Cursor, Claude Code, and a growing set of internal tools — every day. We treat our AI workflow as a product we're shaping together, and we expect you to help shape it.

- 
Teams are small and project-based. You might be 3 engineers and a PM on one project, 2 engineers and a designer on the next, or holding more of the product thinking yourself. You're expected to operate well across different compositions and ship end-to-end.

What you'll do 

- 
Ship customer facing features across the full stack, with a focus on smooth user experiences. You’ll design and build intelligence features from zero-to-one from loosely defined specs, collaborating closely with your product, design, and engineering teammates. You should be comfortable making calls, evaluating outcomes, and iterating on your work to make the best experience for customers.

- 
Sweat the front-end craft. You care about responsiveness, streaming/loading states, accessibility, and the small details that make an assistive feature feel reliable rather than gimmicky.

- 
Stay close to customers. Join customer calls when more context is needed to design the right solution, participate in a support escalation rotation, and watch session recordings on the features you own. Bring that signal back into the work.

- 
Own outcomes, not just output. Before a project starts, you and a PM agree on a specific outcome metric the work is trying to move. You instrument it, and after it ships you're watching the dashboard and talking to customers to ensure its impact.

Co-author the solution. PMs own strategy and sequencing; you bring the judgment and craft for how solutions actually get built. You'll often shape the product thinking too. The best work happens when engineers, designers, and PMs support each other.

Own production readiness from the start. Automation, reliability, monitoring, alerting, and logging are all part of how you ship. The work continues after merge.

- 
Use AI tools every day as part of your craft. We expect fluency with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar. If you saw a way to make the team's AI workflow better tomorrow, you'd say so.

- 
Help us hire. From time to time, partner with our Talent team to interview future teammates. This is one of the highest-leverage things any engineer here does.

About you 

- 
You're a strong, full-stack-capable engineer. You have substantial JavaScript/TypeScript and React experience and real front-end craft, and you take initiative across the stack and ship end-to-end without waiting for someone to own the other half.

- 
You hold a high bar for AI quality. You think in terms of evaluation, verification, and guardrails; you measure whether an AI feature works rather than assuming it does; and you know that more AI-generated code is not the same as more value.

- 
You're genuinely fluent with AI coding tools and treat them as part of your craft. You move fast without sacrificing judgment, and you have a point of view on where these tools are heading.

- 
You're customer-fluent. You actively seek out customer signal because it's how you stay connected to whether your work is actually solving the problem.

- 
You own outcomes. You measure your work, and you're comfortable saying "this didn't move what we hoped, here's what we want to try next," then following through.

-

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

title: Edge Functions Engineer
description:
About Supabase 

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Edge Functions are server-side TypeScript functions, distributed globally at the edge - close to your users. They power use cases such as webhook receivers, AI inferences, OG image generation and real-time bots (Slack, Discord, etc). Built on top of Supabase Edge Runtime : an open-source, Deno-based runtime written in Rust that runs JavaScript, TypeScript, and WASM services.

We want developers to be able to build truly global applications by distributing both compute and data globally. Infrastructure concerns like regions, cold starts, CPU and memory provisioning should fade into the background so developers can focus on iterating on business logic.

We are looking for experienced and passionate engineers to help us go further in this vision.

What You’ll Own 

- 
Evolving Supabase Edge Runtime - an Open-sourced Rust-based host that runs the Deno isolate, manages the main/user runtime split, and enforces per-request memory and CPU limits.

- 
Implementing monitoring, alerting, and OpenTelemetry tracing across the runtime, then using that visibility to drive optimizations that improve latency and reliability of the service.

- 
Working closely with the Deno and other open-source teams, contributing to upstream and relaying our users' requirements.

- 
Participating in an on-call rotation to keep Edge Functions healthy in production.

- 
Help manage and improve features like scheduled functions, background tasks, WebSockets streaming, ephemeral file storage, and custom routing.

- 
Integrating functions more tightly with the rest of the Supabase stack - Auth, Postgres, Storage, and Realtime.

- 
Expanding functions to support more use cases (AI inference, MCP servers, hosting simple websites, URL shorteners).

- 
Improving the DX of developing and debugging functions locally through the Supabase CLI, including DevTools integration, logging, and production parity.

What You’ll Bring 

- 
At least 5 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with strong fluency in Rust and TypeScript.

- 
Experience with V8 Isolates, Deno and the JavaScript runtimes in general.

- 
Experience operating infrastructure at scale - Kubernetes, AWS, Cloudflare Workers, Redis, or comparable systems.

- 
A strong vision for how compute and data can be pushed to the edge.

- 
Bonus: experience building developer-facing CLIs or front-end tooling that sits on top of an infrastructure product.

What We Offer 

- 
Fully Remote 

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Venn 

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn 's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity 

As a Senior Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect, you are the technical owner of our most complex enterprise deals. You will lead the technical sale from first discovery call through architecture review, security sign-off, proof-of-concept and close, working side by side with Account Executives on strategic accounts.

Our buyers are CISOs, CIOs, IT architects and security and compliance leaders at large, regulated organizations. They are replacing or reducing VDI, locking down contractor and BYOD access, and answering to auditors. You will earn their trust by designing a solution that fits their identity, endpoint, network and compliance stack, and by proving it works in their environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You will shape how we run technical evaluations, set the standard for demos and POCs, and bring field insight to Product that changes the roadmap. You are part engineer, part consultant and part storyteller, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in a room of executives.

What You'll Do 

- 
Lead enterprise technical discovery. Partner with Account Executives to map each customer's identity, endpoint, VDI, network and data-protection environment, and the business and compliance drivers behind the project.

- 
Architect solutions for complex environments. Design deployments that integrate with Microsoft 365/Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, Google Workspace, existing VDI, VPN and ZTNA, and endpoint and DLP tooling, and document the reference architecture for the customer's review.

- 
Own proofs-of-concept and technical evaluations. Define success criteria with the customer up front, run the POC end to end, and turn the results into a clear business case.

- 
Run security reviews. Lead security questionnaires, RFP and RFI technical responses, architecture reviews and compliance mapping with customer security, risk and legal teams.

- 
Present at every level. Deliver deep technical sessions for engineers and architects, and concise value-led narratives for CISOs, CIOs and other executive sponsors.

- 
Build the technical business case. Quantify value against incumbent approaches such as VDI, VPN and managed devices (cost, user experience, risk reduction) alongside the Account Executive.

- 
Handle competition. Stay current on the competitive landscape and industry trends, and position Venn against VDI, DaaS, VPN, browser isolation and MDM-based approaches in secure BYOD enablement.

- 
Raise the bar for the team. Build demo environments, POC playbooks, battlecards and reusable solution content, and mentor junior Sales Engineers.

- 
Close the loop with Product. Bring structured customer and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering so it informs the roadmap, and make sure customers feel supported from evaluation through handoff to Customer Success.

- 
Represent Venn externally. Speak as a subject matter expert at webinars, conferences and industry events to build awareness and thought leadership.

What You Bring 

- 10+ years in a technical pre-sales role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect or similar) at a SaaS or security company, with at least 5 years selling to large enterprise and regulated customers.

- A track record of leading the technical side of six- and seven-figure deals with multiple stakeholders, long cycles and formal security review.

- Experience running structured POCs with defined success criteria that convert to closed-won.

- Strong expertise in end-user computing, Windows environments and virtual desktop infrastructure (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or similar), including the limits that drive customers to look for alternatives.

- Hands-on experience with identity and access: Microsoft Entra ID/Microsoft 365, Okta and Google Workspace, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, conditional access and MFA.

- Solid grounding in networking and secure access: VPN, ZTNA, proxies, DNS and firewalls, and secure browsing.

- Working knowledge of endpoint security (EDR/XDR, MDM/UEM), DLP and data-protection controls, and how they behave on unmanaged and contractor devices.

- Fluency in compliance and regulatory frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SEC, FINRA and SOC 2, and in how to map product controls to audit requirements.

- Comfort scripting and working with APIs (PowerShell, Python or similar) to build demos, automate POCs and troubleshoot in customer environments.

- Credibility with technical and executive audiences alike: you can whiteboard an architecture with an engineer in the morning and defend the business case to a CISO in the afternoon.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn technical depth into clear, customer-focused value.

- A consultative approach to discovery: you uncover the real problem, not just the stated requirements.

- Strong ownership and judgment: you prioritize across several deals, know when to bring in Product or Engineering, and make Account Executives better.

- Comfortable traveling to customer sites and events (adjust percentage to your needs).

Nice to Have 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Experience at a growth-stage company, where you helped build the pre-sales function, playbooks or POC process.

- Industry certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft (SC-300, AZ-500, MD-102), Okta, or Citrix/VMware credentials.

- Prior experience selling into financial services, healthcare or other regulated industries.

Why You'll Love Working Here 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

- Competitive compensation and commission opportunities

- Equity at Venn 

- Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance

- Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits

- Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off

- The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering
- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
- Regular use of an AI coding tool
- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
- At least 10 hours a week, starting now
- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

title: Commercial Data Scientist
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

Commercial Data Scientist 

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. 

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. 

As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.

How you’ll make an impact: 

- Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.

- Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.

- Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team 

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

- Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

- Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

- Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

- Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

About you: 

- At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.

- Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment

- Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.

- Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques

- Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

- Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.

- Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.

- Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.

- Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.

- Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.

Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team 

- We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.

- Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.

- The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.

- We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!

Compensation 

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

- Base salary

- Equity (where applicable)

- Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits 

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- 401(k) with company match

- Flexible paid time off and company holidays

- Paid parental leave

- Professional development and learning opportunities

- Wellness and mental health resources

- Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here 

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

- Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

- Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

- Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

- Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools 

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

title: Director, Data Science
description:
Who We Are 

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role 

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact by developing data scientists, setting clear expectations for them, providing hands-on mentorship, and removing blockers.

You will guide and advise multiple data science projects so that they stay on track and have timely delivery with maximum impact. These projects will involve statistical modeling, experiment design, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization. You'll collaborate cross-functionally to validate direction through data, build trust in organizational tactics and strategy by consulting on experiments, and become an expert in our core metrics like searches, installs, and revenue. You'll also drive improvement of the data pipeline. Because of our strong privacy policies, you'll need to think creatively and develop strategies for how we can surface more actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

As a Director, Data Science, you'll help shape our all-in-one privacy solution and join our mission to show the world that protecting your privacy online can be simple. 

About You 

- You have 10+ years of experience in data science or ML engineering, with 4+ years leading teams, and a track record of setting multi-team roadmaps and adapting swiftly as priorities shift.

- You've driven organizational culture toward data-driven decision-making and can translate technical tradeoffs and risks clearly for executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

- You enjoy coaching experienced data scientists who are already highly skilled. You give direct, actionable feedback and you've built teams where people do the best work of their careers.

- You can deploy and iterate ML and NLP solutions in production at expert level, with deep knowledge of when to reach for which tools - especially in constrained environments requiring fast responses and strict privacy standards.

- You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language and stay close to the technical work when it matters most.

- You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid.

- You have strong LLM/AI experience including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and AI-assisted development, and can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces using sparse or privacy-constrained data.

- Preferred: experience at a consumer-facing tech company where data or analytics is core to the product strategy.

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

- United States : $263,300 USD annually

- United Kingdom : £183,850 GBP annually

- Canada : C$346,250 CAD annually

- Europe/Rest of World : €214,950 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. 

Hiring Process 

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire .

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion 

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to 

Please note that:

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team 

Our Defence team is focused on building and embedding human centred AI solutions which give our nation a competitive edge in the defence sector. We collaborate with our clients to bring ethical, reliable and cutting edge AI to high-stakes situations and maintain the balance of global powers essential to our liberty.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Defence clients, you will need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work between 2 to 4 days per week on site with these customers which may require travel to locations throughout the UK.

When not required on client sites, you’ll have the flexibility to work from our London office or remotely from elsewhere within the UK.

About the role 

As a Principal Data Scientist at Faculty, you will drive high impact transformation within our Defence team by taking ownership of complex machine learning delivery and sector specific strategy. You will act as a trusted technical authority and domain expert, leading project scoping, technical selling, and client management to deliver exceptional value. Balancing deep business knowledge with advanced analytical skill, you will shape cutting edge AI solutions, build robust client partnerships, and mentor data scientists across ambitious initiatives.

What you'll be doing: 

- Owning and growing a strategic portfolio of machine learning work specifically tailored to the Defence sector.

- Translating client challenges into technical roadmaps by leading project scoping, delivery, and client engagement.

- Writing exemplary, production grade code to set technical standards on our most sophisticated delivery projects.

- Serving as a technical authority on machine learning across Faculty and representing our capabilities within the wider community.

- Partnering with commercial and delivery teams to drive technical selling, pitching, and business growth.

- Mentoring and guiding junior data scientists through complex problem solving, technical planning, and execution.

Who we're looking for: 

- You bring deep domain expertise within Defence or other industries, allowing you to quickly spot opportunities and maximise impact.

- You enjoy mentoring junior colleagues and have prior direct management experience, inspiring them to continually stretch and grow their technical skill.

- You bring broad knowledge across a range of machine learning techniques, including experience building Generative AI and agentic AI applications with Large Language Models

- You have advanced coding skills in Python and proven experience building and maintaining scalable codebases.

- You excel at making pragmatic decisions, choosing optimal solutions based on time, resources, and complexity.

- You are an engaging communicator who builds trust effortlessly with senior stakeholders and technical counterparts.

The Interview Process 

- Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

- Introduction to Business Unit Technical Director (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (90 minutes) 

- Commercial & Principles Interview (90 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos 

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.
